caption:
Private boat trip out of Funchal, Madeira: the town is behind us and the glasses are still empty.

Two white glasses on the edge of the boat, a bottle in the bucket, and a trail of foam where we have just been.

Look at Funchal from here. The whole town sits on a slope, as if somebody tipped the island towards the sea and the houses slid down as far as the harbour wall.

The glasses are not glass, by the way. White plastic, so they look smarter than they are. Real glass and a wake like that do not get along.

Funchal a ficar pequeno, o mar a ficar grande.

Both our trips leave from Marina do Funchal and head this way, west along the coast. Day Trip with the swim stop at Fajã dos Padres, or Sunset Trip as the light goes, and food on board on either one.

We keep it to five people on board. Send us your dates and we will tell you what is free.
